question: I was wondering if Sekhmet would get an inflamed bladder from waiting too long to go to the bathroom; how many hours a day would Sekhmet spend doing nothing?
answer: When she needs to go to the bathroom, Sekhmet uses the authority of the “Witch of Sloth”, indeed… If she hasn’t got anything to do, she’ll do nothing all day. She’s not sleeping. She’s doing nothing while being awake.
